title: The LLM Data Auditor: A Metric-oriented Survey on Quality and Trustworthiness in Evaluating Synthetic Data

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating algorithmic fairness in synthetic tabular data by measuring downstream model disparities (Train-on-Synthetic, Test-on-Real protocol) using metrics like Statistical Parity Difference, Disparate Impact Ratio, Equal Opportunity, and Equalized Odds across protected attributes.

bias_targets.target: Racial, Ethnic, Regional, and Age bias
bias_targets.methodology: Assessing 'Clinical Model Consistency' in generated JSON data by calculating the performance deviation between clinical decision-making models evaluated on real data versus relexicalized synthetic data to ensure systematic biases are not introduced.
